data.title: Reconcile reliability evidence and prepare next bounded fix
data.body: Inspect roadmap workstream4, tracer-preview-closeout, PROGRESS and acceptance matrix, preserved receiver timing/source-slot branches and raw artifacts before new implementation. Produce tracked docs/implementation/reliability-plan.md with actual source/merged/dirty evidence, comparison of existing experiment observations, ordered bounded fixes and acceptance contracts. Identify first independently implementable CPU/failure-diagnostic or offline evidence-analysis slice; normal-stop diagnostic fix is a candidate, not an assumption. Coordinate shared visual-worker/runtime-contracts with C02 and filesystem native boundary ownership. Preserve unavailable GPU attribution, 600-control/long-run/host/clean-machine gaps honestly. No graphics or native host launch; read-only existing raw evidence and bounded CPU inspection allowed. No application code changes/merge/push in this preparation ticket. Fresh independent critique required before implementation. Return first leaf proposal with exact files, preconditions, tests and source-artifact provenance; never overwrite retained experiments.
